hero_subtitle: A unified platform connecting citizens in distress with authorized emergency responders, official early warning alerts, and verified relief logistics across India.
quick_sos_desc: If you or someone nearby is in immediate life-threatening danger, call 112 directly or submit an urgent report.
step1_desc: Citizens submit geolocated hazard reports with optional photo or video evidence.
step2_desc: Disaster control operators verify submissions, filter duplicates, and assess priority.
step3_desc: Field rescue teams, SDRF, fire units, and nearby NGO volunteers are coordinated.
step4_desc: Track progress in real time through resolution, shelter accommodation, and relief supplies.
